reason: Before the adapter preflight fix, requesting WebGPU without an adapter failed initialization despite the old same-worker WASM retry.

The fork-monitoring wrapper crashed during process cleanup. Its pilot output was replaced before configuration selection. The locked evaluation uses a direct renderer PID limiter, and requires each Node process to exit 0.

First attempt aborted because the worker had nice 5 rather than 0. Two trial burner launches then added nice 5 to an inherited nice 5 and produced roughly 2x slowdown, not 4x. The corrected launcher inherits nice 5, verifies the worker priority, and measured 3.60x. No ASR accuracy run used the invalid setup.
